extraction.Name: Walter Bullard
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not protest when his patent in fee was delivered to him, but signed the receipt and accepted it
extraction.Recorded patent: his patent was filed in the Office of the Register of Deeds, but that he does not know who did it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: land has not been sold; the land covered by his patent was mortgaged to Abraham Land & Loan Co Omaha, Nebr. for $3000.00 and to Hal Cole, Cody, Nebr. for $3000.00
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Abraham Land & Loan Co, Omaha, Nebr. for $3000.00 and to Hal Cole, Cody, Nebr. for $3000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he used this money to educate his children, that he has not paid it back, but that the mortgages have not been foreclosed and that the interest and taxes have been kept up until last year, and that he still holds an equity in his land
extraction.Occupation/Income: works for the Duhamel Hardware Co, Rapid City, So. Dak. for $125.00 per month
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in just fair health; has a wife and three children, but two children are self supporting; all he owns is the equity in his land which he thinks is about $3000.00; has received no aid from the County, State or Government since his patent in fee was granted; affidavit sworn February 28, 1929 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (reservation not explicitly named)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
